target_audience: American tourists visiting Saint-Martin seeking premium boat charters

theme.archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) + Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury Light Variant)
theme.vibe: Accessible luxury, turquoise sea, premium Caribbean, modern, minimalistic

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-light

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy (p-12 to p-24 for sections). Minimal text, let large photos breathe.
spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: MODE A: TETRIS GRID. Asymmetrical grids for image galleries and services. Use gap-8 or gap-12.
spacing_and_layout.hero_overlay: bg-black/30 for real photos to keep them visible while ensuring text contrast. Use text-shadow if needed.

surface_styles.header: Crystal Glass (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/20 shadow-sm)
surface_styles.cards: Flat background, 0px or 4px subtle border-radius, delicate 1px border (#E2E8F0), soft shadow-sm on hover

components.Header: Fixed top, glassmorphism. Logo left, Nav center (desktop), CTA right. Mobile hamburger menu.
components.Footer: Dark theme. Links: WhatsApp, Instagram, Email. Minimalist.

components.Cards: Image top, content bottom. Clean padding, no heavy borders.

technical_requirements.routing: React Router setup with multiple pages.
technical_requirements.motion: Framer Motion for subtle scroll reveals (fade-up) and hover states.
technical_requirements.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='book-experience-btn').
technical_requirements.whatsapp_integration: The booking form submission should construct a URL like: https://wa.me/1234567890?text=Hello%20... and open in a new tab.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette and typography rules. Avoid generic fonts like Inter for headings.
Implement the 5 requested pages: Home (/), Boats (/boats), Activities (/activities), About (/about), and Book (/book).
For the Boats page, build a responsive grid of yacht cards with a filtering mechanism (Catamaran, Sailboat, Powerboat).

For the booking form, use standard HTML/Shadcn form elements. On submit, intercept the event to build a WhatsApp message string using the form data, and redirect using window.open('https://wa.me/<number>?text=<encoded_string>', '_blank').
Maintain the 'luxe accessible' and 'premium Caribbean' vibe through generous padding, large imagery, and thin borders/dividers.
Make sure the navbar is fully responsive with a hamburger menu on mobile.
Use the specific Unsplash image URLs provided in the media section. DO NOT use placeholder services.
